title: Delhi Horsemen, Artillery, and the Flight to Kahnuwan

blocks.text: The expedition grows when one thousand soldiers from Delhi are absorbed into the effort, making the anti-Sikh campaign look like an imperial cause rather than a local outburst.
Material support follows as They offered their own cannons and drew still more men into the ranks, so that A host of Islamic hordes marched towards Lahore with a sense of swelling certainty.
Under that pressure the Singhs slip away and survive by terrain, hiding themselves in the marshy swamp of Kahnuwan even while news reaches them that their parents were being tortured at home.
